title: Reassurance Bucket
description: Mod adds the iconic Bucket from The Stanley Parable to Minecraft. Keep it in your hand — it will talk to you, react to your world, spawn things and judge your other items.
body:
![Stanley in Reassurance Bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93cce3472b9e19e95d763fc321fb4cf43018f153_0.webp)


This mod adds the Reassurance Bucket from *The Stanley Parable* to Minecraft. It is an item. You hold it in your hand. That is all you need to do.

The Bucket notices.

---

## The Narrator

The moment the Bucket enters your hand, the narrator wakes up. He has been waiting. He will speak through a custom font in your action bar, accompanied by a sound that suggests he is very serious about what he is about to say.

He has written **over 427 lines**. About you. About where you are standing. About what is in your inventory. About your decisions. About the absence of decisions. He notices when you stand still too long. He marks every minute, ten minutes, hour, day of holding. He is always talking. You are always listening.

---

## Events

The Bucket does not only talk. It acts.

Hold it long enough and things begin to happen. Not immediately. Not predictably. But inevitably. Events range from pleasant to things you are better off not knowing about in advance. Some affect only you. Some affect everyone on the server.

The Bucket considers all of this completely reasonable.

---

## Atmosphere

Sometimes things go wrong. The Bucket calls these *"moments of heightened atmospheric engagement."* Play with sound on.

---

## The Pedestal

When you first join a world, a pedestal appears near you with the Bucket waiting on top. It was there. It was always going to be there. Pick it up.

---

## Adventure Line™

Sometimes a line appears on the ground leading somewhere. The Bucket recommends following it. The Bucket does not guarantee results. But it is very hopeful.

---

## Other Buckets

The Bucket is aware that other buckets exist. It does not approve. Every bucket in your inventory earns its own dedicated comment. The milk bucket reaction is the most personal. We will not spoil it here.

---

## Technical Details

- Fabric mod for Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Custom narrator font
- **427+ unique narrator lines** in English and Russian
- **Around 100 unique events** — from good to truly terrible
- Milestone lines at 1 min / 10 min / 1 hour / 1 day of hold time
- AFK detection with dedicated lines
- Singleplayer and multiplayer compatible
- No required dependencies beyond Fabric API

---

## FAQ

**Does this need to be installed on the server?**
Yes. All events run server-side.

**Is it compatible with other mods?**
Generally yes. If something breaks, report it on our Discord.

**Can I use this in a modpack?**
Yes, MIT license — go ahead.

**I found two Buckets. What happens?**
The Bucket already knows you were going to ask that. Try it yourself.

---

[Discord](https://discord.gg/5YVm5FRbqF)

---

*The Bucket is watching. It always was. It just wanted you to know that.*
